artifact_lifecycle_matrix.producer_or_authority: M0-11 task executor within the compiled packet
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.freshness: The helper derives the task and packet on every run
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.integrity: Committed source plus deterministic contract and integration tests
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.authenticity: Protected repository history; helper output grants no authority
transitions_and_recovery: A clean read-only result may proceed only after a separate current-run maintainer grant.

authorization_boundary_trace.input: Git status, active or next-legal task, and compiled packet
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Stop on dirty, missing, ambiguous, failed, or changing input

authorization_boundary_trace.input: Skill, helper script, tests, ADR, and aligned operating docs
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Do not persist credentials, grants, raw logs, or runtime state

authorization_boundary_trace.input: Scope, capabilities, commands, reviews, and stop conditions
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Stop rather than broaden task scope or reinterpret policy
The read-only preflight never edits files or creates branches
Do not invoke network, provider, credential, or shipping commands

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: Later protected-delivery workflow plus current-run maintainer grant
authorization_boundary_trace.input: Push, pull request, review, promotion, and merge
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Preflight performs no GitHub write, provider call, or merge

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: Repository CI and protected branch state
authorization_boundary_trace.input: Latest-head checks, review state, merge, and post-merge status
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Preflight neither fabricates nor changes external status

normative_adversarial_matrix.invariant: Preflight only discovers one task, compiles its packet, and leaves HEAD and worktree status unchanged.
normative_adversarial_matrix.positive: One active or next-legal task produces a compact ready-for-authority result.
normative_adversarial_matrix.missing: No eligible task returns a blocker.
normative_adversarial_matrix.contradictory: Multiple active or next-legal tasks return an ambiguity blocker.
normative_adversarial_matrix.tampered: A dirty checkout or changed post-command Git snapshot returns a blocker.
normative_adversarial_matrix.transition_or_recovery: Restore a clean coherent repository and rerun; the helper never repairs state.
normative_adversarial_matrix.concurrency: A changed HEAD or status between the before and after snapshots blocks.

normative_adversarial_matrix.positive: A current listed maintainer grants the exact later action set for the current run.
normative_adversarial_matrix.missing: Absent current-run authority stops before mutation.
normative_adversarial_matrix.stale: A changed task or packet requires a new grant.
normative_adversarial_matrix.contradictory: A denial or non-waivable policy overrides broader permission.
normative_adversarial_matrix.tampered: Roster text, CODEOWNERS, skills, chat history, and ambient credentials are not authority.
normative_adversarial_matrix.transition_or_recovery: Obtain a new bounded grant after restoring current repository state.
normative_adversarial_matrix.concurrency: Each task run requires its own authority and cannot inherit another run's grant.

attack_cases: Helper output is presented as maintainer authority.
A prior preflight result is reused after repository change.
Task routing omits packet scope, commands, reviews, or lifecycle.
Mutation or delivery begins before explicit authority and validation.
A stale task selection is used after plan state changes.

residual_risks: The helper trusts the developer host and installed local tools and is not a security sandbox.
Remote freshness and later mutation authority are intentionally handled by the existing delivery workflow.
